anchors.statement: Create, list, search, save, rename, duplicate, archive, restore and delete workflows with separate saved drafts and published versions.
anchors.test: Check actual reference forms/guards and create/edit/reload/duplicate/archive/unarchive/delete/cancel; retain imported unknown node data, detect stale edits, and leave native flows untouched.

anchors.statement: Import and export actual n8n workflow JSON, folders/tags and metadata without activating imported workflows or exposing credentials.
anchors.test: Round-trip supported Community documents including ports, node variants, pin data and binary references in fresh processes; malformed/unknown profiles remain explicit.

anchors.statement: Provide the actual executing workflow editor with n8n-like navigation, palette/search, node parameters, ports/wires, selection, keyboard/context commands, zoom, undo/redo and persisted layouts.
anchors.test: Compare real browser journeys with the pinned reference at matched viewports, including nested dialogs, shortcuts, disabled states, cancellation and save/reopen.

anchors.statement: Account for and implement all applicable Community node operation/parameter variants, dynamic options and connection types.
anchors.test: Compare pinned reference node/credential catalogs and runtime operation paths; every unknown or unsupported entry remains a failing or blocked mandatory case.

anchors.statement: Support reference expression syntax, built-ins, item linking, previous-node data, workflow/execution context and parameter previews.
anchors.test: Matched reference evaluation corpus including strings, nested values, item indexes, dates, errors, missing data and malicious inputs; no unrestricted host execution from previews.

anchors.statement: Run published and manual draft workflows on Node-RED with execution history, node inputs/outputs, cancellation, failure, retries and recovery.
anchors.test: Use real Node-RED runs and matched reference journeys; verify branching, pairing, loops, async operations, restart, stop/retry behavior and no repeated uncertain external effects.

anchors.statement: Preserve manual, scheduled, webhook and applicable Community triggers and activation/deactivation behavior.
anchors.test: Exercise publish/unpublish, edited drafts, incoming events, time zones, duplicate events, restart and unavailable credentials without inference dependency.

anchors.statement: Provide applicable Community credential creation, editing, testing, OAuth and workflow bindings through Body-authorized encrypted storage.
anchors.test: Use synthetic secrets and controlled endpoints; wrong keys, redaction, revocation, destination restrictions, editor/memory/export/log exclusion and failed/cancelled setup.

anchors.statement: Implement all applicable Community instance, personal, workflow, execution, data, environment and security settings and nested commands.
anchors.test: Reconcile source and runtime visibility by edition; edit/reload/reset/error/permission tests at each nested form and verify downstream behavior.

anchors.statement: Answer ordinary user conversations automatically using the complete verified PRIMER and the explicitly owner-configured OpenRouter model/provider and bounded spending policy.
anchors.test: Exercise real owner-approved provider exchanges, recall/correction, checked observations, source/route/policy revocation, durable exact replay and no retries/fallback on unknown outcomes; synthetic providers are separate evidence.

anchors.statement: Keep Heart, editor, executing workflows and permitted limbs responsive while inference is slow, absent, rejected or failed.
anchors.test: Hold/fail a provider request during real native automation and limb work; verify one pending cognition request, queue bounds and restart reconciliation without another generation after commit.

anchors.statement: Offer a complete product-wide evidence review and explicit authenticated Baker decision bound to this full contract and current integrated candidate.
anchors.test: Refuse absent, stale, failed, omitted or merely synthetic live-provider evidence; recheck every mandatory preservation case cumulatively, then retain the owner scoped acceptance act separately from all model proposals.

goal: Deliver full reviewed n8n 2.46.4 self-hosted Community user-function and GUI parity on the Node-RED Body, with an owner-configured automatic OpenRouter MIND and separate explicit Baker acceptance.

oven.assumption: Consistent execution of sufficiently explicit recipe

target.description: Full self-hosted Community workflows, automation canvas, node operations and parameters, expressions, data, executions, credentials, settings, relevant nested commands and error/permission states. Node-RED remains the execution Body. Unknown or missing behavior remains mandatory.
target.fidelity_semantics: Existing numeric Fidelity declaration retained. Deepen nested command, parameter, dataflow, failure, persistence and cross-system consequences; discovery completeness is an explicit mandatory gate.
